The wording needs to be exactly "Community Picnic", "12 June 2027", "12:00–15:00", and "Maple Park, East Gate", and the flyer should be portrait 4:5. I tend to overthink these things, so I am happy to leave the visual decisions to you. Please do not include any extra text. You can pick the colours yourself.
